title: NZ Holiday Parks — The Complete Family Guide (TOP 10 vs Freedom Camping)
meta_desc: Discover the best NZ holiday parks, compare TOP 10 holiday parks to freedom camping, and get tips on facilities, costs, and booking
intro: When planning a family road trip in New Zealand, choosing the right accommodation can make all the difference. With over 300 holiday parks to choose from, it can be overwhelming to decide between TOP 10 holiday parks and freedom camping. In this guide, we'll break down the pros and cons of each option, helping you make an informed decision for your next family adventure.

sections.heading: TOP 10 Holiday Parks vs Freedom Camping
sections.body: TOP 10 holiday parks offer a range of facilities, including powered sites, cabins, and amenities like swimming pools and playgrounds. In contrast, freedom camping allows you to park your campervan or tent in designated areas, often with limited facilities. When deciding between the two, consider the needs of your family and the activities you have planned.

sections.heading: Facilities and Amenities
list: Amenities like swimming pools, playgrounds, and BBQ areas

sections.heading: Booking Tips
sections.body: To ensure availability, book your holiday park or campsite in advance, especially during peak season (December to February). You can book online through the TOP 10 holiday parks website or through the Department of Conservation (DOC) website for DOC campsites. Be sure to read reviews and check the park's policies on cancellations and refunds.

sections.heading: Best Holiday Parks by Region
list: North Island: Bay of Islands Holiday Park, Rotorua TOP 10 Holiday Resort
South Island: Queenstown Lakeview Holiday Park, Wanaka Kiwi Holiday Park

sections.heading: Regional Drive Times and Attractions
sections.body: When planning your itinerary, consider the drive times between destinations. For example, the drive from Auckland to Rotorua takes around 3 hours, while the drive from Queenstown to Wanaka takes around 1 hour. Be sure to check the opening hours and prices of attractions like the Bay of Islands Hole in the Rock cruise (around $100 per person) and the Rotorua Wai-O-Tapu geothermal park (around $32.50 per person).
